question: In the final match of the Asian Games _________ held in Jakarta, Indonesia, India secured gold by defeating South Korea with a score of 2-1 in football.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1962**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asian Games** of **1962** were held in **Jakarta, Indonesia**.
 
• India secured a **gold medal** in the **football tournament** by defeating **South Korea** with a score of **2-1**.
 
• This victory marked a significant achievement for India in international football during that era.
 
• The 1962 Asian Games were the fourth edition of the games and witnessed participation from various countries across Asia.
 
• **Jakarta**, the capital of Indonesia, served as the host city for the event.
 
• India’s football team showed exceptional performance, making it one of the most memorable moments in Indian sports history.
 
• The games were organized under the auspices of the **Olympic Council of Asia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **1966**__

 __
 
• The **Asian Games of 1966** were held in **Bangkok, Thailand**.
 
• India participated in various events but did not win gold in football during this edition.
 
 
 
• **1970**__
 __
 
• The **Asian Games of 1970** were held in **Bangkok, Thailand**.
 
• India’s performance in football during this edition was notable but did not result in a gold medal.
 
 
 
• **1958**__
 
 
• The **Asian Games of 1958** were held in **Tokyo, Japan**.
 
• India’s football team reached the semifinals but did not win the gold medal.
